issues.where: he should have wheeled vehicles and four-footed animals carry water
issues.problem: The ca after cakri-catuṣpadam ('and for the vehicles and animals too') points to the reading the draft puts second: water is to be carried FOR the vehicles and animals as well as for the men, not BY them. A double-accusative causative with ca joining the object to nothing is strained. Prefer: 'In a waterless region he should have water carried, according to the length of the road and as far as he is able, for the wheeled vehicles and four-footed animals as well' (Hindi: 'जलरहित प्रदेश में वह मार्ग की लम्बाई के अनुसार, यथाशक्ति, गाड़ियों और चौपायों के लिए भी जल ढुलवाए।'). A person should choose; confidence stays medium.
issues.fix: see problem
